title: [T1-a policy vocabulary] Policy-declared risk classification: a slice-level fact-tier table plus a closed node-property fact-id vocabulary the daemon derives, never a planner tier
description:

Leaf of three (this → [T1-b producer] → [T1-c reader]); PLAN IN BUILD ORDER.

THE GAP, MEASURED AT HEAD 5b3d7313: the core evaluator derives the tier ONLY from tier-bearing FACTS with strong truth — packages/core/src/policy/policy-evaluation.ts:56-63 `assessRisk` folds `fact.tier` via maxTier; no tier-bearing fact leaves computedTier null (:51 "never a silent R0"). Rules cannot express properties: `PolicyRule` (policy-contract.ts:79-84) = {effect, obligations, requiredFactIds, ruleId} and `assessRules` matches on requiredFactIds only (:119); `PolicySlice` (:95-99) = {autoApprovalOptIns, rules, sliceRef}. The only production fact source is `resolvePolicyFact` (apps/daemon/src/bootstrap/policy-fact-resolver.ts:44) → readPolicyRisk → the ACTIVATION-written policy-risk record (circular for a fresh run). So "policy-declared risk from node properties" needs TWO vocabulary pieces that do not exist: (1) a POLICY-side table mapping fact ids to tiers (declared in the slice, so a policy revision — not daemon code, not an agent — decides risk); (2) a DAEMON-side closed vocabulary of node-property fact ids (e.g. `node.command_kind:<kind>`, `node.scope:<scope>`, `node.target:<target>`) derived deterministically from inspectable node content the graph revision already carries (measure the node content contract: graph-supersede-approval-binding.ts:66-67 reads `successorContent.nodeAuthority.authorities[].nodeKey`; approval-intent-sources.ts:35 `approvedNodeScope`).

DELIVER: core policy contract gains `riskClassifications: readonly { factId: string; tier: PolicyRiskTier }[]` on PolicySlice (exact-key rosters updated: the authority reader's `exactObject(slices[0], ["autoApprovalOptIns","rules","sliceRef"])` bootstrap-policy-authority-reader.ts:189, slice codec/digest `derivePolicySliceDigest`, install validation) and a pure `deriveNodePropertyFacts(nodeContent, classifications)` in @moe/core that yields PolicyFactInput[] with truthClass DAEMON_VERIFIED for each property the slice classifies and NONE for unclassified properties — so the evaluator's existing null-tier path REFUSES (unclassifiable ≠ lowest tier). No daemon wiring here (T1-b). Consumer: [T1-b producer].

`deriveNodePropertyFacts(nodeContent, classifications)` (pure, @moe/core) emits, for each inspectable node property in the CLOSED vocabulary, a PolicyFactInput {factId: '<vocabulary>:<value>', tier: <classified tier or null>, truthClass: 'DAEMON_VERIFIED'} — and an UNCLASSIFIED property yields tier null so the evaluator's computedTier stays null and the evaluation is unclassifiable (fail-closed, its own arm per ruling condition 3); a property outside the vocabulary is REFUSED with an exact code (never silently skipped); the vocabulary is a frozen roster with a bidirectional pin test.

No planner/agent field can carry a tier: an arm proves that a node content record carrying any `tier`/`riskTier`/`risk` key is refused by the node content validator (exact code+layer) and that deriveNodePropertyFacts reads only the vocabulary's properties (mutation: add a `tier` property to a node -> the refusal arm reds).
